jcr:content.jcr:title: Payroll Delegation Of Authority Change Instructions

text.text:
Instructions for Completing a Payroll Services Delegation of Authority Form                

 

   Effective Date                                        Complete the date the document goes into effect.

   Agency/Unit                                           Complete "242"/and the three (3) digit reporting unit number used to identify where the paychecks for this area should be distributed.                                                                          There are multiple fields that should be completed if the Division has multiple reporting unit numbers that will be monitored by the                                                                                appropriate administrator signing this document.

   Division                                                  Select the appropriate Division (e.g. Academic Affairs.)

   Dept/Dept ID                                          Complete the Department name (e.g. Faculty Affairs & Records) and the Department ID number (e.g. 1XXXX.)

   College                                                   Select the appropriate College (e.g. College of Business and Economics) if applicable.

   Faculty/Staff Attendance                     In this section you will add and/or delete the primary and alternate Faculty, Administrator and Staff Timekeeper(s) for the reporting unit(s)                                                                    listed on this document. Please remember that as you add to these roles you may need to delete accordingly. You may do so on the                                                                          same sheet.

   Timekeeper                                            Complete the printed name(s) of the Timekeeper(s) being added and/or deleted for the unit(s) you've listed in the section identified for                                                                        the action you are updating. Note the message in red.

   Approving Official                                   Complete the printed name and signature of the Approving Official being added and/or deleted for the unit(s) you've listed in the section                                                                      identified for the action you are updating. The Approving Official has the authority to sign the following documents; Attendance Forms -                                                                      Absence and Additional Time Worked Report (form 634), Authorization for Extra Hours, Hourly/Intermittent Timesheets, Dock Forms and                                                                    miscellaneous PR docs in the section identified. This delegate must be an MPP or equivalent.        

   Certification Report                                 Complete the printed name and signature of the Approving Official being added and/or deleted for the unit(s) you've listed in the section                                                                     identified for the action you are updating. The Approving Official has the authority to sign Attendance Certification Reports.
                                                                  This delegate must be an MPP or equivalent.       

    Student Attendance                             In this section you will add and/or delete the primary and alternate student Timekeeper(s) for the reporting unit(s) listed on this                                                                                     document. Please remember that as you add to these roles you may need to delete accordingly. You may do so on the same sheet.

    Timekeeper                                            Complete the name(s) of the Timekeeper(s) being added and/or deleted in the section identified for the action you are updating. Note                                                                         the message in red.

    Student Time Sheet                               Complete the printed name and signature of the supervisor authorized to approve student schedules and attendance documents that                                                                         are being added and/or deleted in the section identified for the action you are updating.

    Approving Official CD-048                      Complete the printed name and signature of the Approving Official for the reporting unit(s) listed in the section identified for the action                                                                          you are updating. This delegate must be an MPP or equivalent.

    WARRANT COORDINATOR                  Complete the printed name(s) and signature(s) of the Warrant Coordinator(s) that are being added and/or deleted in the section                                                                                  identified for the action you are updating. Warrant Coordinators are authorized to pick up warrants for the unit(s) listed. Note the                                                                                  message in red.

    CMS Student Confirmation Tickets     Complete the printed name(s) and signature(s) of the Approving Official for the reporting unit(s) listed in the section identified for the          Primary/Alternate                                     action you are updating. Please remember that as you add to these roles you may need to delete accordingly. You may do so on the                                                                           same sheet. This delegate must be an MPP or equivalent.

    APPROVALS                                           Complete the printed names and signatures of the Department Head, College Dean, and Division Head or designee for the reporting                                                                         unit(s) listed granting signature authority to those stated on this document.
